verses.english: The Besieger!
What is the Besieger?!
What will show you what is the Besieger?!
Thamudand ‘Ad denied the Cataclysm.
As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the Cry.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ
verses.english: And as for ‘Ad, they were destroyed by a fierce icy gale,
verses.transliteration_text: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin

verses.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ
verses.english: which He clamped on them for seven gruelling nights and eight days, so that you could see the people there lying about prostrate as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
verses.transliteration_html: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun
verses.transliteration_text: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun

verses.english: So do you see any remaining trace of them?

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.english: Then Pharaoh and those who were before him, and the towns that were overturned, brought about iniquity.
verses.transliteration_html: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati
verses.transliteration_text: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati

verses.arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً
verses.english: They disobeyed the apostle of their Lord, so He seized them with a terrible seizing.
verses.transliteration_html: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan
verses.transliteration_text: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.english: Indeed when the Flood rose high, We carried you in a floating ark,
verses.transliteration_text: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati

verses.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ
verses.english: that We might make it a reminder for you, and that receptive ears might remember it.
verses.transliteration_html: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun
verses.transliteration_text: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
verses.english: When the Trumpet is blown with a single blast
verses.transliteration_html: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun
verses.transliteration_text: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun

verses.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
verses.english: and the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with a single levelling,
verses.transliteration_html: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan
verses.transliteration_text: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan

verses.english: then, on that day, will the Imminent [Hour] befall
and the sky will be split open—for it will be frail on that day—

verses.arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌۭ
verses.english: with the angels all over it, and the Throne of your Lord will be borne that day by eight [angels].
verses.transliteration_html: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun
verses.transliteration_text: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
verses.english: That day you will be presented [before your Lord]: none of your secrets will remain hidden.
verses.transliteration_html: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun
verses.transliteration_text: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.english: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, ‘Here, take and read my book!
verses.transliteration_html: Faamm<u>a</u> man ootiya kit<u>a</u>bahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu h<u>a</u>omu iqraoo kit<u>a</u>biyah
verses.transliteration_text: Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah

verses.english: Indeed I knew that I will encounter my account [of deeds].’
So he will have a pleasant life,
in an elevated garden,
whose clusters [of fruits] will be within easy reach.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.english: [He will be told]: ‘Enjoy your food and drink, for what you had sent in advance in past days [for your future life].’
verses.transliteration_html: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati
verses.transliteration_text: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.english: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, ‘I wish I had not been given my book,
verses.transliteration_html: Waamm<u>a</u> man ootiya kit<u>a</u>bahu bishim<u>a</u>lihi fayaqoolu y<u>a</u> laytanee lam oota kit<u>a</u>biyah
verses.transliteration_text: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah

verses.english: nor had I ever known what my account is!
I wish death had been the end of it all!
My wealth did not avail me.
My authority has left me.’
[The angels will be told:] ‘Seize him, and fetter him!
Then put him into hell.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.english: Then bind him in a chain, seventy cubits in length.
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.english: Indeed he had no faith in Allah, the All-supreme,
verses.transliteration_html: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi
verses.transliteration_text: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi

verses.english: and he did not urge the feeding of the needy,
so he has no friend here today,
nor any food except pus,
which no one shall eat except the iniquitous.’
I swear by what you see
and what you do not see:
it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: and it is not the speech of a poet. Little is the faith that you have!
verses.transliteration_html: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.english: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer. Little is the admonition that you take!
verses.transliteration_html: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona

verses.english: Gradually sent down from the Lord of all the worlds.
Had he faked any sayings in Our name,
We would have surely seized him by the right hand
and then cut off his aorta,

verses.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
verses.english: and none of you could have held Us off from him.
verses.transliteration_text: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena

verses.english: Indeed it is a reminder for the Godwary.
Indeed We know that there are some among you who deny [it].
And indeed it will be a [matter of] regret for the faithless.
It is indeed certain truth.
So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme.
